decisions.claim: B has a job (works after which B has free time)
decisions.reason: The phrase 'your time after work' in a question directly presupposes that B has work/a job. This is a definite possessive presupposition ('your') establishing B works.
The phrase 'in vacation' with the possessive 'your time' presupposes B has vacation time. The question structure 'after work or in vacation' treats both as B's time periods.

c3 ('B works (has a job)') is bidirectionally equivalent to c1 ('B has a job'). Both are grounded in the same presupposition from 'after work' in turn 1. c1 is slightly more precise in its formulation.
